faces.name: Your Favorite Missing Character
faces.oracleText:
During deckbuilding, choose any two colors, up to three creature types, a new name, and one of the following abilities for this card to have.
• When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or a lore counter on target Saga you control.
• At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1.
• Equip costs you pay cost {1} less.
• Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.

faces.name: Your Inescapable Doom
faces.oracleText:
(An ongoing scheme remains face up.)
At the beginning of your end step, put a doom counter on this scheme, then this scheme deals damage equal to the number of doom counters on it to the opponent with the highest life total among your opponents. If two or more players are tied for highest life total, you choose one.

faces.name: Your Mana Rock
faces.oracleText:
Your Mana Rock enters the battlefield tapped.
During deckbuilding, write two different colors on Your Mana Rock.
{T}: Add one mana of a color written on Your Mana Rock.

faces.name: Your Mistake Is My Triumph
faces.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, each player mills three cards. Then you put a permanent card from among the milled cards onto the battlefield under your control.

faces.name: Your Nightmares Are Delicious
faces.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, each opponent who has more than five cards in hand discards cards equal to the difference. Then if fewer than three cards were discarded this way, you draw three cards.

faces.name: Your Own Face Mocks You
faces.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, choose up to two target creatures your opponents control. For each one, create a token that's a copy of it. If you created fewer than two tokens this way, create a number of 4/4 colorless Scarecrow artifact creature tokens with vigilance equal to the difference.

faces.name: Your Plans Mean Nothing
faces.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, any number of target players each discard their hands. Each opponent draws cards equal to the number of cards that player discarded minus one. Then if you discarded a card this way, draw seven cards.

faces.name: Your Puny Minds Cannot Fathom
faces.oracleText: When you set this scheme in motion, draw four cards. You have no maximum hand size until your next turn.
